Status and errors are not announced: errors, 'no results', Ask AI answers and 'Listening…' are silent for screen readers; toggles expose no selected/pressed state

Tickets: TFA-94745 etc. · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S19 Ask sheet in the visual lane: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA), phone width and WebKit, both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Ask About This Patient is reachable from all three tabs (Pre-Round, Encounter, Post-Round). (TFA-92593 AC 2)
  • U8 Works in both Hospital and Nursing Home contexts (ground rule 3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92593 AC 9)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Ask sheet open on Pre-Round, Encounter and Post-Round in both contexts, and once with an answer shown; desktop Chrome, Pixel 7, iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When Run axe and the overflow / tap-target checks on each open sheet

Then Presets, input, Dictate and Ask buttons have accessible names; the answer region is announced; nothing off-screen at 390 px

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Visual-lane findings are evidence for a person to review (serious/critical axe violations and off-screen elements listed), not Pass/Fail. The iOS keyboard covering the input is a device check (S20)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-15.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
